posts.text:
Two big updates to the $100K Hackathon 🏴‍☠️

1/ We have disqualified the #1 product.

After reviewing the entry, we found that work started before November 16 and that it was a reworked version of an existing product.

Both break the requirement to build a completely new business from zero after the hackathon starts.

This decision applies to the product. Jacky can still participate with a new business that meets the rules. The disqualified product’s revenue won’t carry over.

Here's the updated leaderboard: https://t.co/lZUe71oAFc

2/ We’re changing how the $100,000 is distributed.

I’ve been reading your feedback. Having one person win all the cash made the prize feel out of reach for many of you.

My goal with this hackathon is to get people to finally ship the business they’ve been thinking about. If more chances to win help more people keep going, that makes sense to me.

So we’re replacing the single $100K cash prize with:

🥇 1st: $30,000
🥈 2nd: $20,000
🥉 3rd: $10,000
4th: $8,000
5th: $7,000
6th: $5,000
7th: $5,000
8th: $5,000
9th: $5,000
10th: $5,000

Plus the iPhone Duo and MacBook Neo. 12 winners in total!

The cash pool stays at $100,000. Winners are still ranked by verified profit.

Building apps changed my life. I’m doing this with @jackfriks because I want more people to experience that too.

Thank you for helping us make this hackathon better 🫡
posts.text_zh:
$100K Hackathon 的两项重大更新 🏴‍☠️

1/ 我们取消了排名第一的产品的参赛资格。

在审核该作品后，我们发现它的开发工作在 11 月 16 日之前就已经开始，而且是对一款已有产品的改版。

这两点都违反了「黑客松开始后必须从零打造一个全新业务」的要求。

这项决定针对的是这款产品。Jacky 仍然可以用一个符合规则的新业务继续参赛。被取消资格的产品所产生的收入不会结转。

更新后的排行榜在这里：https://t.co/lZUe71oAFc

2/ 我们要调整这 $100,000 的分配方式。

我一直在看大家的反馈。一个人独得全部现金，让很多人觉得这个奖可望而不可即。

我办这场黑客松的目标，是让大家终于把一直想做的业务做出来、上线。如果增加获奖机会能让更多人坚持下去，我觉得这很合理。

所以我们把单一的 $100K 现金大奖改成：

🥇 第 1 名：$30,000
🥈 第 2 名：$20,000
🥉 第 3 名：$10,000
第 4 名：$8,000
第 5 名：$7,000
第 6 名：$5,000
第 7 名：$5,000
第 8 名：$5,000
第 9 名：$5,000
第 10 名：$5,000

再加上 iPhone Duo 和 MacBook Neo。一共 12 位获奖者！

奖金总池仍是 $100,000。获奖者仍然按已验证利润排名。

做应用改变了我的人生。我和 @jackfriks 一起做这件事，是希望更多人也能有这样的体验。

感谢大家帮我们把这场黑客松变得更好 🫡
